serialization: SHA-256 of sorted compact JSON; see campaign_refresh.persistent_identity

previous_claim_scope.migration: Shared NIL_UUID claims remain historical; each player receives one personal claim for previously shared rewards. Existing personal keys, quest/task IDs and ownership remain intact.

previous_content.migration: One additive optional Cardboard Box quest, task, personal reward and caption. Existing quest/task/reward ownership and claim scope are unchanged; all original hashes are checked on the original objects.

previous_questbook.migration: Add construction item tasks without replacing existing task IDs, reward IDs, ownership or personal claim scope. Existing FTB completion timestamps remain intact.
